name: System DNS uses nice-dns
headline_when_unhealthy: This computer is not using nice-dns
notes: Platform adapter: resolv.conf on Linux, networksetup and scutil on macOS.

name: Cached answers work
headline_when_unhealthy: Pi-hole is not answering from its cache
notes: A cached answer is not upstream health; never use it for the hero.

name: Install matches its record
headline_when_unhealthy: The install no longer matches its record
notes: Linux only. Unhealthy reasons start with install-security-drift: show the reason in full.

name: Container runtime
value_when_healthy: count of containers from the reason

name: Tor proxy (socat)
headline_when_unhealthy: The Tor proxy is not running
notes: Only one of tor-socat and tor-haproxy is present.

name: Tor proxy (HAProxy)
headline_when_unhealthy: The Tor proxy is not running

name: Tor proxy generation
headline_when_unhealthy: The Tor proxy could not be read
notes: A hash that changes when the proxy restarts; indeterminate when unreadable.

name: Unbound answers
notes: Unhealthy reasons start with control: or route:.

name: Cloudflare onion
headline_when_unhealthy: The Cloudflare onion route is not answering
notes: The route the controller promotes to once it is sustained.

name: Cloudflare Tor exit
headline_when_unhealthy: The Cloudflare Tor exit route is not answering
notes: The seeded route (ND_ROUTE_SEED), usable while the onion is cold.

name: Quad9 Tor exit
headline_when_unhealthy: The Quad9 Tor exit route is not answering

name: Cloudflare onion, legacy port
headline_when_unhealthy: The legacy Cloudflare route is not answering

name: Route table
headline_when_unhealthy: The route table cannot be read
notes: Printed only when routes/providers.tsv cannot be read; then no route:<id> rows exist.

name: the raw id
headline_when_unhealthy: the raw id, then: check failed
notes: Any name not listed. The contract lets new observations appear; never drop them.
